reviewer: Assistant visual review of every current positive source photograph against the returned description; not an independent specialist
rule: Matched means at least one actual physical defect or frayed/broken-material cue is described at the reference feature. A generic alert, wrong unrelated feature, or damage enum without corresponding evidence is insufficient. Wrong kinds, anatomy and extra claims are tracked separately; this is not all-claims accuracy.

cases.note: At least one returned description corresponds to the visibly broken, frayed or missing reference material. This does not certify every additional claim, exact damage type, severity, or cause.
